tools.name: search_lenders
tools.description: Find mortgage lenders by name. Returns up to 20 lenders with LEI, name, city, state and applications in the newest year.

tools.name: get_lender
tools.description: One lender's facts, name history, parent, exemption status and national figures for each loan group, with counts.

tools.name: get_lender_in_area
tools.description: One lender's figures in one state or metro area beside the figures for all lenders there.

tools.name: compare_lenders
tools.description: Two to four lenders, figure by figure, for the same area and loan group.

tools.name: find_lenders_for_borrower
tools.description: Lenders active in a state with comparable approval and price figures for a loan profile given as bands. Ordered by one key that the caller chooses, never by a blend.

tools.name: get_lender_history
tools.description: The release shows one lender's figures for one loan group for each year, with counts.

tools.name: list_lenders_in_area
tools.description: The release lists lenders with at least 50 applications in one state or metro area for one loan group. It includes their figures and counts. The caller chooses one sort key. The list never combines keys.

tools.name: get_area_market
tools.description: The release shows figures for all lenders in one state or metro area for each loan group beside nationwide figures.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: The release lists states and metro areas with applications in the newest year. You can filter by state or part of a name.

tools.name: get_lender_fha_performance
tools.description: Returns HUD's published FHA loan performance for one lender. The result includes the compare ratio, two-year FHA loans, seriously delinquent loans and claims, with HUD's data as of the stated date. The result appears only when the lender is tied to its HUD record.

tools.name: get_lender_complaints
tools.description: Returns CFPB mortgage complaint counts for one lender by year. The result covers complaints about applying or closing and complaints about servicing. It returns a rate per 1,000 applications only when the minimums are met. The result appears only when the company is tied to the lender.

tools.name: get_lender_public_orders
tools.description: Returns CFPB enforcement actions that name one lender. Each result includes the date, agency, title and link. The result appears only when the company is tied to the lender.

tools.name: get_benchmark_rate
tools.description: Returns the federal average prime offer rate (APOR) for a week and loan term from the FFIEC tables.

tools.name: get_loan_limit
tools.description: Returns the FHFA conforming loan limits for one county and year. The result covers one to four units.

tools.name: get_method
tools.description: The scope rule, the minimum samples, the model card summary and the limits of the data.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: Every source file in the release with its edition, date and SHA-256.
